entries.9ffcd226bb92ccd9: The company is responsible for planning women's wear and fashion accessories for customers across a wide range of ages, and for sales to its consolidated subsidiary Honeys Co., Ltd., which sells women's wear and other products to domestic general consumers. Its domestic stores are mainly in-shop women's apparel specialty stores, with locations in all 47 prefectures across Japan; the number of directly operated stores at the end of the current consolidated fiscal year was 864. Revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥56,182 million, and Honeys Co., Ltd.'s revenue (excluding internal revenue between consolidated companies) was ¥55,943 million.
entries.ca7c46c1c998d109: Headquartered in Iwaki, Fukushima Prefecture, it forms a group with 2 consolidated subsidiaries and, as a SPA company for women's apparel and fashion accessories, plans, sells and manufactures apparel and fashion goods. Consolidated employees for the fiscal year ended May 2026 numbered 6,921.
entries.d600f3ff8c672aa4: A holding company headquartered in Iwaki City, Fukushima Prefecture, selling through 864 stores nationwide and its own EC site as an SPA that handles women's apparel planning, manufacturing and sales end to end.
